description: Every reader knows how fresh the numbers are, in their own time zone. SmartVisuals Last Refresh & Data Freshness shows "Refreshed 3 hours ago (today 06:04) - Succeeded - Data through yesterday" on any report page, keeps ageing while the report is open, and says why when the data is not fresh. Your time zone, not the server's. Store the refresh time in UTC and the browser converts it for each reader, daylight saving included, with the zone named in the reader's language (CEST, EDT or GMT+2). DAX cannot do this: NOW() and UTCNOW() run in the service's zone. Three inputs, all tested. Refreshed At says when the model refreshed, Data Through says what the data covers, and Last Status says whether the last run worked. A model that refreshed on time but loaded nothing since Tuesday is stale, a blank Data Through is flagged, and a failed run marks the source stale, with the reason printed. States you can read without colour: Fresh, Ageing, Stale and Unknown, each with its own icon shape and word. Business time by default: a quiet weekend is not stale. Working days, optional working hours and holidays count; calendar time is one click away. The refresh schedule: type your schedule and the visual knows when a run is late ("the 06:00 refresh is late") and when the next one is due, skipping holidays.
